research.topic: Using the Newcastle vs Everton football hype to teach exam‑stress‑management for Indian high‑school students
verified: Shared chants can enhance social connection and reduce perceived stress, which may in turn increase motivation.
Chanting has been shown to reduce cortisol, and light movement during chanting may help release endorphins.
Shared chants boost motivation and lower perceived stress

research.hook: Kabhi notice kiya Newcastle aur Everton ke match ke dauran stadium ki chanting aapke exam stress aur phone‑distractions ko kaise kam kar sakti hai?
research.tip: Every 30 minutes of study, put phone on Do‑Not‑Disturb, stand up and do a 2‑minute Newcastle‑Everton chant with claps, then resume studying
dropped: Phone notifications cause attention slips lasting up to 20 seconds (unsupported)
